stories.title: US moves third aircraft carrier toward Iran; 2,000 Marines deploy
stories.summary: The US is sending the USS Theodore Roosevelt strike group and the Makin Island amphibious force (2,000+ Marines) toward the Middle East, a buildup a US official says will finish by November. The escalation comes as the US-Iran war nears its eighth month, with Trump signaling possible renewed strikes after the midterms.

stories.title: Russia suffers record losses as it aims to freeze Ukraine
stories.summary: Russia lost 46,230 troops killed or wounded in September, its highest 2026 monthly toll, while shifting to jet-powered drones to attack Ukraine's power grid ahead of winter. Kyiv says it needs $27bn more as both sides blow through their defense budgets.

stories.title: US delivers F-16V Block 70 fighter jets to Taiwan
stories.summary: Two F-16V Block 70 jets, part of an $8bn 66-plane deal, landed in Taiwan Friday after delays tied to Beijing's objections. They arrive amid Taiwanese concern about Washington's commitment to arming the island against China.

stories.title: Supertanker struck in Strait of Hormuz during Iran war
stories.summary: A 2.5-million-barrel supertanker was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, catching fire though the crew was reported safe. The strike highlights the war's ongoing threat to key shipping lanes and oil supply routes.

stories.title: Android's new sideloading restrictions go live in four countries
stories.summary: Google's new Android sideloading guardrails are now active in four countries, tightening how users can install apps from outside the Play Store. The change is meant to curb malware but draws criticism over reduced user flexibility.

stories.title: Nvidia's $500B chip-financing plan faces Wall Street skepticism
stories.summary: Wall Street is skeptical of Nvidia's roughly $500bn plan to use its chips to help finance the AI buildout, questioning whether the bets can truly fund the boom. The pushback highlights doubts over who pays for surging AI infrastructure costs.

stories.title: Google launches first test satellite for orbital AI data-center project
stories.summary: Google launched its first test satellite for a project to deploy AI data centers in orbit, opening a new front in the race to put computing above Earth. Orbital data centers could ease terrestrial power and land limits, but face cooling and cost hurdles.

stories.title: Amazon signs 20-year nuclear power deal to back AI data centers
stories.summary: Amazon struck a 20-year nuclear power agreement to secure clean baseload electricity for its expanding AI data-center footprint. The deal also lifted Constellation Energy and NuScale Power shares as demand for carbon-free power surges.

stories.title: Browns sign CB Myles Bryant and TE John FitzPatrick to practice squad
stories.summary: Cleveland added cornerback Myles Bryant and tight end John FitzPatrick to its practice squad following Thursday night's win over Pittsburgh. The moves bolster depth as the team turns toward Week 5.

stories.title: Monken says Watson can build off second-straight win
stories.summary: Offensive coordinator Todd Monken said Deshaun Watson can build off his second consecutive winning start after the Browns improved to 3-1. Watson's steadier play is stabilizing Cleveland's offense early this season.

stories.title: Browns edge Steelers 27-24 as Szmyt hits 56-yard FG at the buzzer
stories.summary: Andre Szmyt made a 56-yard field goal with seconds left to give Cleveland a 27-24 win over Pittsburgh on Thursday Night Football, the Browns' third straight victory and a 3-1 start. The turnaround continued an early-season surge in the AFC North.

stories.title: Ohio State at Iowa: 3 keys for Buckeyes in top-15 showdown
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch breaks down what No. 5 Ohio State (3-1) must do to beat No. 14 Iowa at Kinnick Stadium on Saturday. A win would give the Buckeyes momentum before a stretch that includes trips to Indiana and USC.

stories.title: FP2: Leclerc fastest as Mercedes keeps its update under wraps
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc topped second practice for this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang as Mercedes kept its updated package under cover. Track order remains fluid heading into qualifying.

stories.title: Antonelli: Sepang best track to try 2026 F1 cars in the rain
stories.summary: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli called Sepang the best venue to test the 2026-generation cars in wet conditions, with rain in the forecast. Rain in practice could prove decisive for setup and qualifying.

stories.title: FP1: Verstappen fastest as updated Mercedes makes debut
stories.summary: Max Verstappen set the pace in first practice for the Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang as Mercedes ran its updated car for the first time. Verstappen, still chasing his first 2026 win, showed strong early form.

stories.title: Engine penalties for trio shake up Bahrain GP grid
stories.summary: Engine penalties for Hadjar, Lindblad and Colapinto are set to reshuffle the Bahrain Grand Prix grid, complicating their race weekends. The grid drops could also influence midfield strategy and team tactics.

stories.title: 5 dead, 1 critical in Columbus drug incidents tied to cychlorphine
stories.summary: Five people died and one is in critical condition after Columbus drug-related incidents over a 24-hour period linked to cychlorphine, a synthetic opioid the DEA says can be far more potent than fentanyl. Authorities warn the illicit drug supply is increasingly hard to predict.

stories.title: DeWine signs 90-day Ohio gas tax suspension
stories.summary: Gov. Mike DeWine signed a bill suspending Ohio's gas tax for 90 days, with an average driver estimated to save about $80. The state will pull $725m from its general fund to cover the lost revenue.
